messages.subject: FIRMA and Gene 1.0 ST
parts:
Hi,

Got a quick question. Can the FIRMA code for exon array analysis page
be applied to Gene 1.0 ST arrays?

Thanks!
Yu Chuan

messages.author: 1ff63ac4948de366
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] FIRMA and Gene 1.0 ST
parts:
Hi Yu Chuan.

Short answer is yes, you can. For example, see Figure 5 of:
http://www.biomedcentral.com/1471-2105/10/156

That paper also suggest a more fine-grained approached for Gene 1.0 ST
arrays.

Cheers,
Mark
